boundary: Review observations against exact captured candidate bytes. Corrections may already be in progress; no candidate is promoted and no independent specialist or Lifecycle acceptance is asserted. Follow-up must compare corrected meaning, not merely refresh hashes.

findings.exactSourceText: reuse cannot ignore current authorization or policy.
findings.materialFinding: Lifecycle separation does not establish current authorization and policy on reuse.

findings.exactSourceText: Inventory and preserve this worker, Office/PDF/OCR paths, and its consumers
findings.materialFinding: Generic document-service ownership does not preserve the distinct worker, Office/PDF/OCR inventory, cancellation and admission boundary.

findings.exactSourceText: Perform dependency-closure analysis, isolated packaging tests, and owner-approved extraction or public integration.
findings.materialFinding: Dependency closure warning does not define isolated packaging tests and owner-approved extraction/public integration.

findings.exactSourceText: Version schemas and public contracts as needed.
findings.materialFinding: Frozen contract ownership does not define schema/public-contract versioning.

findings.exactSourceText: Use Shared localization and formatting.
findings.materialFinding: Tools ExperienceLanguage is not Shared localization and formatting.

findings.exactSourceText: For each selected release record source/version/digest, license expression and files, notices, modification/distribution mode, transitive/native dependencies, compiler/build flags, codecs, plugins, model weights, datasets, fonts/textures/audio assets, patent/trademark concerns, security advisories, supported platforms and replacement path.
findings.materialFinding: Three general supply-chain references do not cover the full selected-release evidence inventory.

findings.exactSourceText: Use available portfolio/build tooling for lockfiles, SBOM, license checks, security scanning and artifact publication
findings.materialFinding: Immutable pinning and reproducible build gates do not establish reuse of the available owner portfolio/build tooling.

findings.exactSourceText: Target WCAG 2.2 AA for supported Web processes and assess media-authoring/output accessibility separately [W04].
findings.materialFinding: Text spacing alone does not state WCAG 2.2 AA target and separate media-authoring/output accessibility scope.

findings.exactSourceText: protect against overwrite, traversal and symlink surprises.
findings.materialFinding: Decompression bounds do not establish destination overwrite protection; traversal and symlink scope must be explicit.

findings.exactSourceText: Version or idempotency conflict |
findings.materialFinding: Version conflicts do not cover same idempotency key with different request fingerprints.

findings.exactSourceText: Decoder/library versions and encoder threading may matter.
findings.materialFinding: Codec build flags do not by themselves bind execution threading and decoder/library determinism context.

findings.exactSourceText: Audit records contain necessary protected identity and product facts, not raw operational logs.
findings.materialFinding: Operational metric redaction does not define protected audit identity/product facts versus raw operational logs.

findings.exactSourceText: Stale workers cannot commit progress, register canonical output or publish finality.
findings.materialFinding: Progress fencing must independently cover canonical output registration and finality publication.

findings.exactSourceText: Native/Python/Rust/WASM engines run in qualified workers
findings.materialFinding: Worker isolation does not define exact native/Python/Rust/WASM qualification envelope.

findings.exactSourceText: add a second only for a demonstrated quality, locality, hardware, interoperability or resilience need.
findings.materialFinding: Separately qualified alternative profile needs the original demonstrated quality/locality/hardware/interoperability/resilience reason gate.

findings.exactSourceText: Pin runtimes/dependencies and validate updates before promotion.
findings.materialFinding: Immutable pinning must also bind validation before promotion.

findings.exactSourceText: Produce SBOM, attribution and redistribution/source-offer material where required.
findings.materialFinding: SBOM/attribution/redistribution requirements must include applicable source-offer material.

findings.exactSourceText: Preserve existing owner-approved bounded worker paths, such as document intelligence, within their published restrictions [R15]
findings.materialFinding: Scene/temporal API ownership does not establish bounded worker preservation under published cancellation/admission restrictions.

findings.exactSourceText: Advanced fluids, long-form generation, scientific models and spatial workflows remain specified.
findings.materialFinding: Video generation family presence does not establish long-form generation scope and bounded duration semantics.

findings.exactSourceText: Image/video generations can start from text without an existing binary input artifact
findings.materialFinding: Both text-to-image and text-to-video must permit text without mandatory binary references, verified against required fields.

findings.exactSourceText: Preserve their document-extraction integration
findings.materialFinding: Preserved document-extraction consumers must not be silently reduced to scene/temporal recognition scope.
